Indian and Japanese Air Chiefs Fly Tejas During Joint Exercise

During the 'Veer Guardian 2026' joint exercise, Indian Air Force Chief Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh and Japan Air Self-Defense Force (JASDF) Chief General Takehiro Mori flew in India's indigenous Tejas fighter jet. Air Chief Marshal Singh described the flight as a significant step in India-Japan defense cooperation, stating that the exercise strengthens trust, interoperability, and friendship between the two air forces. General Mori expressed gratitude for the experience.
